case: The park-on-mismatch route is deleted from record-registry.json. The edge predicate survives and every check that reads predicates still passes.
why: Measured at bcfd658: three edge deletions on the new records, three runs, three exit 0. This is the consequential one. With `recomputed_at_release -> parked_on_mismatch` gone, that phase has exactly one outbound edge, to `matched`, so a recompute that disagrees with the admitted class set has nowhere to go but release. `parked_on_mismatch` is the phase whose row reads "it never resolves downward"; unreachable, it never resolves at all. Deleting the transition is a different attack from deleting the call: the predicate survives, the attachment pin still resolves, and only the ROUTE is gone.
